literal: He who does not desire pleasure within pleasure, does not have the experiencing of pain within pain.
translation: He who does not crave pleasure when experiencing pleasure, will not suffer from pain when experiencing pain.
modern: இன்பம் வந்தபோது அந்த இன்பத்தை விரும்பி ஏங்காதவன், துன்பம் வந்தபோது அந்தத் துன்பத்தை அடைந்து வருந்த மாட்டான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the power of equanimity in overcoming life's hardships. The poet explains that a person who does not get overly attached to or crave pleasure during prosperous times remains emotionally balanced. Because they do not lose themselves in joy, they do not get crushed by sorrow when difficult times arrive. By maintaining a steady mind through both ups and downs, one becomes immune to the suffering caused by adversity.
